plan: Given my private value of $4, the goal is to maximize profit by bidding below or at my value. Since bids are in $0.1 increments, I will bid $0.1 to minimize the risk of overpaying. This ensures I only win if others undervalue the item significantly, which is unlikely given the value range. This strategy minimizes potential losses while preserving my endowment, as winning with a bid above my value would result in a net loss.

Given my value of $40, I aim to bid close to maximize my profit while ensuring I win. Assuming others bid around their value or slightly lower, I'll bid slightly above half my value to outbid a potential middle bid. This minimizes risk and maximizes profit if I win. I'll bid $25 to balance winning chances and profit margin, considering the third-highest bid will likely be much lower than my value.

My value is $32. To maximize profit, I must bid below this value to ensure a net gain if I win. I will bid slightly below my value to increase my chances of winning while minimizing the cost. A bid of $30 balances potential profit and winning likelihood, assuming others bid randomly between $0 and $49. This strategy maximizes expected profit by winning with a high chance and paying less than my value.
